sanctuary.enter: You enter the Sanctuary of the Imperial City. Blood may not be spilled here.
sanctuary.leave: You leave the Sanctuary of the Imperial City.
sanctuary.aggressor: You attacked someone in the Imperial City. The Sanctuary no longer protects you.
sanctuary.staff_attacked: Sanctuary: {name} attacked {victim} in {area} and lost the Sanctuary's protection.
sanctuary.status_off: The Sanctuary is off: nobody is protected in the Imperial City now.
sanctuary.status_outside: You are outside the Sanctuary. It covers the Imperial City inside its walls, not the Arena.
sanctuary.status_protected: You are in the Sanctuary ({area}). It protects you: blood may not be spilled here.
sanctuary.status_aggressor: You are in the Sanctuary ({area}), but you attacked someone: it does not protect you for {time}.
sanctuary.status_aggressor_outside: You are outside the Sanctuary. You attacked someone there: it will not protect you for {time}.
sanctuary.cleared: {name} is no longer an aggressor: the Sanctuary protects them again.
sanctuary.turned_off: The Sanctuary is off: nobody is protected in the Imperial City, and every aggressor's streak ended.
sanctuary.cmd.sanctuary: /sanctuary - where you stand with the Sanctuary of the Imperial City: inside or outside, protected or an aggressor
sanctuary.cmd.asanctuary: /asanctuary [<number> clear|on|off] - the Sanctuary's aggressors, end a player's aggressor streak, or turn the Sanctuary on or off
